title: Let's Learn English Lesson 32
subtitle: Welcome to the Treehouse!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 32: Welcome to the Treehouse! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! Today is a big day. My first children's show is on television! Woo-hoo! I'm excited and nervous.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！今天是重要的一天。我的第一個兒童節目要上電視了！嗚呼！我又興奮又緊張。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 你好，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, Ms. Weaver!
dialogue.zh: 你好，韋弗女士！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Some people are going to watch your children's show. After they watch it, they'll tell me what they liked, and what they didn't like.
dialogue.zh: 有人要看你的兒童節目。看完後，他們會告訴我喜歡什麼，不喜歡什麼。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, dear.
dialogue.zh: 哦，天哪。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: They're in the conference room. They're in the conference room.
dialogue.zh: 他們在會議室。他們在會議室。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, everyone. I'm Anna, and thanks for coming!
dialogue.zh: 大家好。我是安娜，謝謝你們來！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Today you are going to watch my new show. I hope you like it.
dialogue.zh: 今天你們要看我的新節目。希望你們喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: What is the show about?
dialogue.zh: 這個節目講什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: It's a children's show.
dialogue.zh: 這是一個兒童節目。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: But we are not children!
dialogue.zh: 可我們不是孩子！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This children's show is different. I hope.
dialogue.zh: 這個兒童節目不一樣。我希望是。

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: I don't really like children's shows.
dialogue.zh: 我其實不太喜歡兒童節目。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Shhh, please. The show is starting!
dialogue.zh: 噓，拜託。節目開始了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, hi! Just give me one minute ….oops! Oh well. I can fix that later.
dialogue.zh: 哦，嗨！給我一分鐘……哎呀！算了。我以後再修。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello, I'm Anna! Welcome to "The Time Traveling Treehouse!" This is not a usual treehouse. It can time travel! That is why it's called "The Time Traveling Treehouse."
dialogue.zh: 你好，我是安娜！歡迎來到“時光旅行樹屋”！這不是普通的樹屋。它可以時光旅行！所以才叫“時光旅行樹屋”。

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Anna, do not forget me.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，別忘了我。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Of course not! This is my partner, MINDY!
dialogue.zh: 當然不會！這是我的搭檔，MINDY！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: My name means Massive Information Navigation Device, for You!
dialogue.zh: 我的名字是 Massive Information Navigation Device, for You！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That means we can travel to many places and learn many things. Kids from all over the world ask us questions. We find them answers!
dialogue.zh: 意思是我們可以去很多地方，學很多東西。世界各地的孩子問我們問題。我們幫他們找答案！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Woo-hoo! That is right, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 嗚呼！沒錯，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, what is our first question?
dialogue.zh: MINDY，我們的第一個問題是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Layla asks us this question.
dialogue.zh: 萊拉問我們這個問題。

dialogue.speaker: Layla
dialogue.en: Hello, Anna! Hello, MINDY! I'd like to know -- how do you play baseball?
dialogue.zh: 你好，安娜！你好，MINDY！我想知道——棒球怎麼打？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is a great question! MINDY, we need to find her an answer!
dialogue.zh: 這是個好問題！MINDY，我們得給她找個答案！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: I know that we can find it, Anna!
dialogue.zh: 我知道我們能找到，安娜！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where am I now? MINDY, now I am on a snowy mountain!
dialogue.zh: 我現在在哪裡？MINDY，我現在在一座雪山！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: That is a good place to learn how to ski.
dialogue.zh: 那是學滑雪的好地方。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, MINDY, but it cannot teach us about baseball! And I don't know how to ski!
dialogue.zh: 是的，MINDY，可它教不了棒球！而且我不會滑雪！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Sorry, Anna. Let's try again.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，安娜。我們再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Where am I now!? MINDY, I am in the ocean! An ocean cannot teach us about baseball!
dialogue.zh: 我現在在哪裡！？MINDY，我在海里！海教不了棒球！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Please don't yell, Anna. The ocean can teach us about surfing.
dialogue.zh: 請別喊，安娜。海可以教衝浪。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, MINDY, it can teach us about surfing … and sharks! Ahhh!
dialogue.zh: 是的，MINDY，它可以教衝浪……還有鯊魚！啊——！

dialogue.speaker: MINDY
dialogue.en: Anna, please wait. I need to fix my navigation device.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，請等一下。我得修一下導航裝置。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: MINDY, please fix it faster. And get me out of here … now!
dialogue.zh: MINDY，請修快一點。還有，現在就帶我離開這兒……立刻！

dialogue.speaker: Announcer
dialogue.en: Whoa! Is Anna going to be lost forever? Next week, you can watch part two of "The Time Traveling Treehouse!"
dialogue.zh: 哇！安娜會永遠迷路嗎？下週，你可以看“時光旅行樹屋”第二集！

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 1
dialogue.en: Aw, man! Will the shark eat her?
dialogue.zh: 哎呀！鯊魚會吃掉她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 2
dialogue.en: Will Anna find the answer?
dialogue.zh: 安娜會找到答案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Coworker 3
dialogue.en: Please tell me the ending!
dialogue.zh: 請告訴我結局！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, you liked it?
dialogue.zh: 所以，你們喜歡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Coworkers
dialogue.en: Yes!
dialogue.zh: 喜歡！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, you can watch the ending next week!
dialogue.zh: 好，你們下週可以看結局！

dialogue.speaker: Coworkers
dialogue.en: Noooooo!

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Don't forget to watch next week!
dialogue.zh: 別忘了下週看！

What does Layla want to know?
Where does MINDY send Anna the second time?
